_comment: A dynamic entry with one same-chunk and one cross-chunk dynamic importer needs no facade: the same-chunk importer collapses to `Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_target(), ns))` and the cross-chunk one to `import(host).then(n => (n.init_target(), n.ns))`, so every entry path carries the trigger. The implementation chunk must publish exactly the dynamically used `value` export even though another entry retains aliases and unrelated exports from the same barrel; its getter must keep a live mutable backing binding. Entering `b` still must not run entry `a`, and `target` still must initialize exactly once.
